text: Hello, I'm a childminder and I've got an 11 year old boy staying with me tonight because his parents are stuck abroad with a cancelled flight, so I'm the one in charge and honestly I'm quite frightened because I don't want to get this wrong. He started saying his ear hurts this evening, the right one, and he keeps pulling at it and holding the side of his head. I took his temperature and it was 39.2, which seemed high to me so I took it again and got the same. The other thing I want to mention so you don't think I've missed it is that his cheeks are very red, but they went that way this afternoon when the children were all out playing in the park in that freezing wind, and the younger ones were the same, so I'm putting that down to the cold. I've got his parents' consent to give medicine and I have children's paracetamol here but I wanted to check with someone first before I do anything, and also whether I need to get him seen tonight or whether this can wait until the morning. I've got his parents on the phone whenever I need them but they're as worried as I am and can't do much from where they are. Sorry this is so long, I just wanted to give you everything.
